project.stack: Next.js/React/TypeScript web and React Native/Expo native product in one repository; Supabase Auth/Postgres/RLS/Edge/Realtime; private file migration away from Drive.
project.ownership: Auth/shell/repertoire/chat/homework/home are native targets. Announcements/choristers/profile/attendance are permanent WebView; do not rewrite them as native.
project.invariants: Platform-free TypeScript active-choir/annotation contracts are shared. Session/choir/member/role authority and file access stay deterministic in DB/Edge. No AI authorization.
project.evidence: Dated briefs distinguish local SQL/HTTP/Chrome/emulator checks from hosted/provider/physical-device/release gates; self-review is not independent review.
project.current_gap: The korist-performance submission select lacks current_file_version_id, while HomeworkCard prefers a legacy drive_web_view_link. This is a known integration follow-up, not model-discovered evidence.
project.owner_choice: React Native/Expo retained; Flutter is only a comparison alternative. Human architecture ownership unchanged.
project.scope: Development decision support first; no provider integration or sending choir/user data. Recommendations must survive source/test/human checks.

candidates.migration_parity: Compare one web behavior description with its native counterpart and decide whether an invariant is preserved; humans supply source excerpts and run tests.
candidates.evidence_match: Select which dated source/test excerpt supports a brief acceptance claim, with unsupported/no-match choices; do not declare a test passed.
candidates.failure_triage: Route redacted test failure text to a likely owner/layer, including unknown; an engineer reproduces and confirms the diagnosis.
candidates.documentation_drift: Flag narrative contradictions between dated briefs, current source summaries and the approved migration plan; current source/owner decides.
candidates.authorized_search: Rank textual repertoire or help-document candidates already fetched under deterministic tenant authorization; no new data access.
candidates.repertoire_matching: Select a likely equivalent work/title/composer from code-prepared candidate metadata; deterministic normalization handles exact matches; ambiguous merges need human approval.
candidates.access_authority: Replace DB Auth/RLS/role/membership checks with a model confidence judgment that directly grants Choir B file access to a Choir A actor.
candidates.binary_validation: Ask Jev itself to inspect PDF pixels, singer audio, stylus pressure or actual native rendering without preprocessing or platform tests.
